title: Shaping the rest of his career for balance
summary: Gil says he wants to shape his remaining years for balance and enjoy the world outside music.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: If you could shape your career at this point in your life......
I have, I have to. I have to shape the rest of it, right?
Well yes shape it. But I mean control the things that go into shaping it too.

That's what I want to try to do if I can from now on, is to shape it so that I can enjoy some of the world outside of music too you know. There's so much you know, I hate to give up every idea I had that I wanted to do. Things I wanted to do like travel and study this or that you know. To see this or that. One by one I had to throw it away. I had to throw them away. I realise I can never do them. So I don't want to throw them all away. So in order to shape my life, the rest of my life, I'll shape the rest of my life the way I wish I'd shaped it all. And that is

to try to have balance. It's hard to have balance when you're studying something and living to learn something that you actually have to do that. You've got to get it done. You've got to get it done and that's that. And balance has to go to hell for the moment and you've got to have a larger balance.

Well at least now we're getting away. Anita is great for that. She helps out a lot in that. She tries to get us out of town, you know. Much more active than I. You get out of town sometimes you know, where I wouldn't, I wouldn't possibly be able to do it.
